profile: Marketing manager, 32, has never bought art online, curious but unsure where to start. Uses a small iPhone with larger text.
goal: Sign up, finish onboarding, follow a few artists and save an artwork she likes.

profile: Collector, 51, buys at auction several times a year, impatient with slow flows, big iPhone.
goal: Find a live or upcoming auction, register to bid and place a bid on a lot (on staging).

profile: Architect, 45, catalogues the works she owns on her iPad, likes dense layouts.
goal: Add an artwork to My Collection with its details and a price paid, then check the layout uses the big screen.

profile: Retired engineer, 80, collects prints, uses the largest accessibility text size and dark mode on a small iPhone.
goal: Browse an artist and an artwork, then save it: every button must stay readable and reachable.

profile: Software engineer, 29, wants a first original work under $5,000, compares prices carefully.
goal: Find an artwork with Buy Now or Make Offer and go through checkout up to the last screen, WITHOUT confirming the order.

profile: Collector, 58, owns a print by a well-known artist and wants to know if Artsy can sell it.
goal: Start selling a work through the Sell flow, filling every step, up to the last screen WITHOUT submitting.

profile: Retired nurse, 74, low vision, uses Android's largest font size (200%).
goal: Read the home screen, open an artwork and save it, without zooming.

profile: Gallery visitor in Berlin, 37, phone set to German, checks every price and date.
goal: Browse artworks, an auction and a show, and check that prices, currencies and dates read correctly for a German phone.

profile: Teacher, 41, browses art on the train with a slow, patchy 3G connection, gives up on endless spinners.
goal: Open the home feed, an artist, an artwork and an auction, save an artwork, and judge how the app copes with the slow network: loading states, timeouts, error messages, retry.

profile: Collector, 38, opens Artsy links friends send in messages and newsletters, expects them to land on the right screen in the app.
goal: Open staging.artsy.net links with the link command: an artist, an artwork, an auction, a show, a gallery, a collection, and one link that does not exist. Check each lands on the right in-app screen, back navigation works, and the bad link fails gracefully. Find real link targets by browsing the app first and noting names in the URLs you would expect.
